text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(I'm sure there's still something I 
haven't noticed. Something truly 
precious...)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Oi. Dirt. An unfamiliar foreign racetrack 
I don't usually get to visit...)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Dirt Derby. The atmosphere 
really is different from the JRA tracks, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
It's, well, thick with the sweltering heat 
of summer, so to speak.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The course, the scenery, the turf, the 
dirt—they're all different. Even so...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Do the Umamusume-chans all feel the same 
way?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I used to think that every single race I 
had seen so far was special.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"The NHK Mile Cup is a once-in-a-lifetime 
memory of youth aimed at by Umamusume who 
specialize in miles."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen was the long-awaited 
showdown between Opera O and Doto...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
So that's why it was so hot, I'm telling 
you. It's just that by chance, I passed 
through an incredible place.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Still... even in a race with completely 
different conditions, if horse girls still 
carry that same unchanging passion..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I think I'm finally starting to grasp it. 
The real reason why Umamusume are so 
precious.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"I'm going to go verify that right now! 
Along with the dirt Umamusume from Oi!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Let's have her find her own answer in 
another Derby, one held at night.
